name: Yasova's mark
description: Two sweeping curves Yasova gouges into stone at intervals, a trail charting the storms that Bolas asked for to find Ugin.

description_citations.text: "Unwritten" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 14 Jan 2015.

timeline.summary: Sarkhan, arrived in Tarkir's past, follows the woman with the dragon-claw staff up a mountain by her trail of marks.
timeline.quote: gouged two sweeping curves into it with the clawed staff she carried.
